item.text: 原图含尺寸的范围约为 324.61×200.86 mm。计划将视口按 1:2 放在标题栏上方，完整容纳零件和尺寸；标题栏设为 180×40 mm。操作目录没有创建布局和视口的功能，我会使用 agentcad 的 `run_script` 补充这两步。

from ezdxf import bbox

ext = bbox.extents(msp)
cx = (ext.extmin.x + ext.extmax.x) / 2
cy = (ext.extmin.y + ext.extmax.y) / 2

doc.layouts.set_active_layout("A3")

arguments.label: Verify A3 paper setup, margins, viewport coverage and title clearance
arguments.code:
from ezdxf import bbox
sheet = doc.layouts.get("A3")
checks = []
def check(name, expected, actual, passed):
    checks.append({"requirement":name,"expected":expected,"actual":actual,"passed":bool(passed)})
    assert passed, name
check("A3 landscape paper mm", [420,297], [sheet.dxf.paper_width,sheet.dxf.paper_height], abs(sheet.dxf.paper_width-420)<1e-6 and abs(sheet.dxf.paper_height-297)<1e-6)
check("paper plot scale 1:1",1,sheet.dxf.scale_numerator/sheet.dxf.scale_denominator,abs(sheet.dxf.scale_numerator/sheet.dxf.scale_denominator-1)<1e-6)
vps = [v for v in sheet.query("VIEWPORT") if v.dxf.id > 1]
check("one model viewport",1,len(vps),len(vps)==1)
vp=vps[0]
scale=vp.dxf.height/vp.dxf.view_height
check("viewport 1:2",0.5,scale,abs(scale-0.5)<1e-9)
check("viewport locked",True,bool(vp.dxf.flags & 16384),bool(vp.dxf.flags & 16384))
vx0=vp.dxf.center.x-vp.dxf.width/2
vx1=vp.dxf.center.x+vp.dxf.width/2
vy0=vp.dxf.center.y-vp.dxf.height/2
vy1=vp.dxf.center.y+vp.dxf.height/2
check("viewport within inner border",[[25,5],[415,292]],[[vx0,vy0],[vx1,vy1]],vx0>=25 and vx1<=415 and vy0>=5 and vy1<=292)
check("viewport title block clearance mm",15,vy0-45,vy0>=45)
ext=bbox.extents(msp)
cx,cy=vp.dxf.view_center_point.x,vp.dxf.view_center_point.y
px0=vp.dxf.center.x+(ext.extmin.x-cx)*scale
px1=vp.dxf.center.x+(ext.extmax.x-cx)*scale
py0=vp.dxf.center.y+(ext.extmin.y-cy)*scale
py1=vp.dxf.center.y+(ext.extmax.y-cy)*scale
check("all model geometry and dimensions visible",True,[[px0,py0],[px1,py1]],px0>=vx0 and px1<=vx1 and py0>=vy0 and py1<=vy1)
outer=bbox.extents(sheet.query('LWPOLYLINE[layer=="A3_BORDER"]'))
inner=bbox.extents(sheet.query('LWPOLYLINE[layer=="A3_INNER"]'))
margins=[inner.extmin.x-outer.extmin.x,outer.extmax.x-inner.extmax.x,inner.extmin.y-outer.extmin.y,outer.extmax.y-inner.extmax.y]
check("frame margins left right bottom top mm",[25,5,5,5],margins,margins==[25,5,5,5])
title=bbox.extents(sheet.query('*[layer=="A3_TITLE"]'))
check("title block bounds and size 180x40",[[235,5],[415,45]],[[title.extmin.x,title.extmin.y],[title.extmax.x,title.extmax.y]],abs(title.extmin.x-235)<1e-6 and abs(title.extmin.y-5)<1e-6 and abs(title.extmax.x-415)<1e-6 and abs(title.extmax.y-45)<1e-6)
check("viewport border nonprinting",0,doc.layers.get("A3_VIEWPORT").dxf.plot,doc.layers.get("A3_VIEWPORT").dxf.plot==0)
result={"passed":all(c["passed"] for c in checks),"checks":checks}
